description: Permission-level Attack and Control Escalation Recognition (PACER) dataset for detecting rugpull vulnerabilities in Ethereum smart contracts.

positive_contracts.description: Confirmed rugpull contracts from the ISSTA SoK dataset

no_path.description: Contracts where PACER found zero permission escalation paths (true negatives)

F_positive.description: False positives — flagged by PACER but manually verified as benign

others.description: Contracts that failed Slither initialization (pipeline failure)

directory_structure.P: Rugpull (positive) contracts with source code and full detection results
directory_structure.N/benign: Benign contracts with detection paths (true negatives)
directory_structure.N/no_path: Contracts with zero permission escalation paths found (true negatives)
directory_structure.N/F_positive: False positive contracts (flagged but manually verified as benign)
directory_structure.N/others: Contracts with pipeline failure (no detection results)

per_contract_files.code: Solidity source code (.sol), compile.json, metadata.json, detect_result.json

source: Organized from PACER_DATASET/ with only core code/ and result/ files retained
